title: Re-probe the mcp-gateway CI pipeline and attach closure evidence
description: After tasks 1 and 2, run `/probe-cicd-env example-co` scoped to app mcp-gateway, repo mongodb-mcp-server, against the checkout at applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server updated to the merged commit. Check that rule CICD-SBOM-02 no longer fails for .github/workflows/docker-publish.yml and that the new observation for sebi-cscrf-2024:GV.SC.S5 cites the image record and .cdx.json from task 2. Attach the SARIF export path and the image files as task evidence. The finding is resolved by refresh-soc only after two consecutive probe-cicd-env runs without the fingerprint, so schedule the second run before the initiative dueAt. The probe is read-only and needs no deployment window.
